subject: Renewal: interim attestation option for PO cutoff — next steps
messages:
From: Michael Tran <mtran@cumuluslogistics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Natalie Chen <nchen@cumuluslogistics.com>
Date: 2026-05-20 09:14 -0700
Subject: SOC2 Type II for renewal + question on provisional attestation

Hi Hannah,

Hope you’re well. We’re preparing the PO for the expansion committed in Q3 and legal asked for the latest SOC 2 Type II report and confirmation of audit coverage dates. Our internal procurement deadline to issue the PO is June 25 to hit internal quarter close.

Two quick asks:
- Can you provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II PDF and the audit period it covers?
- If the full Type II report isn’t posted before our PO cutoff, would Redwood provide a provisional attestation / bridge letter acceptable to our legal team until the official report is published?

I’ve attached our standard procurement instructions for reference.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation so we can plan.

—Michael
Michael Tran
Senior Procurement Manager
Cumulus Logistics
procurement@cumuluslogistics.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>

Cc: Natalie Chen <nchen@cumuluslogistics.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-20 11:02 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 Type II for renewal + question on provisional attestation

Hi Michael — thanks for the heads up. Happy to help and congrats on the expansion. Short answers up front:
- Yes, we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending 2025-12-31.
- We do offer a signed interim attestation (bridge letter) that our security team signs; it's commonly accepted by procurement/legal while the final report is being routed to customers.

Plan and next steps:
1) I’ll share the SOC2 PDF and a draft bridge attestation by end of day Monday (May 24).
2) Ben from Security/Compliance will confirm the exact coverage wording required by legal.
3) If that looks good, we can send a DocuSign-ready attestation and copy to your legal queue.

Could you confirm the exact PO cutoff date you need (June 25 as noted) and whether your legal prefers the attestation to explicitly list service scope (API, embeddings, inference)?

Thanks — will follow up with attachments.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Security & Compliance (Sales Ops)
Redwood Inference
—

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Michael Tran <mtran@cumuluslogistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-21 08:37 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 Type II for renewal + question on provisional attestation

Thanks Hannah. Michael — quick note from our side on the attestation:
- The bridge letter we provide is signed by our Head of Security and includes the audit period covered by the last Type II (through 2025-12-31), a statement confirming no material control exceptions since that period, and the provisional coverage dates (we typically state coverage through the expected Type II publication).
- To be procurement-friendly, we can add explicit service-scope language (API inference, embeddings, managed hosting) — please confirm the exact services to list.
- Typical lead time: we can produce a DocuSign-ready bridge within 48 hours once scope language is confirmed.

Attaching a procurement-acceptance template for reference; legal has used this format before.

Ben Carter
Sr. Manager, Security Compliance
Redwood Inference
